about: The inventory is shared by every map: items leave with the player on every trip and are added to the destination's on arrival, so the map left keeps none (no duplicates). Milk stacks by grade; torn blueprint pieces go through the game's combine, so pieces held on two maps (saves from before this change) complete a blueprint when they meet. Also covers the give_item / give_blueprint tool actions, which never passed their item before.

steps.why: a torn piece of a blueprint
give_blueprint works (it lost its item before)
a third piece arriving from another map (as in a save from before this change)
three pieces met: the blueprint is complete
